questions.stem: How do nature reserves help protect endangered species?

options.text: By keeping animals in cages away from predators
By providing protected habitats where species can live and breed without human disturbance
By introducing non-native species to increase biodiversity
By removing all vegetation to create open space

questions.explanation: Nature reserves provide protected habitats where endangered species can live and breed without threats from human activities such as hunting, farming, or development. They help maintain natural ecosystems and the organisms that depend on them.
